user.title: Add a silo
user.description: Choose the sensor that measures the grain: usually an ultrasonic sensor at the top of the silo, pointing down (see the ESPHome example in Silo Card). The next steps describe the silo's shape and what it holds.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the sensor's device name.
data_description.source: Any length unit works (mm, cm, m, in, ft).
data_description.unit: Every length in the next step is in this unit.

shape.title: Shape of the silo
shape.description: Lengths in {unit}. The silo's lowest point (the floor, or the tip of the hopper) is height 0.

data.diameter: Diameter (the side, for a square silo)

data_description.rings: The straight wall, from the eave down to the hopper or floor. A wall without rings is 1 ring as tall as the wall.
data_description.outlet: 0 when the hopper comes to a point.
data_description.sensor_height: Above the silo's lowest point. Leave empty when the sensor is at the very top.

contents.title: What the silo holds
contents.description: For the weight, choose a grain (its standard bushel weight), or enter your own density or the manufacturer's capacity. Leave them all empty for the volume only.

data.include_roof: Full means filled to the peak

data_description.density: Replaces the grain's standard bushel weight. Your own test weight is more accurate.
data_description.capacity: Weight of the whole silo when full, or of one full ring, in the weight unit below, from the manufacturer. Replaces the density.
data_description.include_roof: Otherwise full is at the eave, and grain in the roof shows above 100 %.
data_description.capacity_per: For “One full ring”, the hopper and roof get the weight of their own volume: a cone holds a third of a ring as tall.

error.roof_height: Enter the roof's height, or choose a flat roof.
error.hopper_height: Enter the hopper's height, or choose a flat floor.

abort.already_configured: This sensor already has a silo.

init.title: Silo options
init.description: The sensors keep their IDs. Changing the unit converts the lengths already entered.
